description_en: Queries minor engine versions that are available for an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance or an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance

kebab_example: aliyun rds describe-db-mini-engine-versions --engine MySQL --engine-version 5.7 --node-type HighAvailability --storage-type local_ssd --dedicated-host-group-id dhg-4n0000 --minor-version-tag rds_20220731 --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBMiniEngineVersions

parameters.help_en: The database engine of the instance. Valid values: MySQL and PostgreSQL
parameters.name: engine

parameters.help_en:
The database engine version of the instance. Valid values:

Valid values when you set the Engine parameter to MySQL: 8.0, 5.7, 5.6, and 5.5
Valid values when you set the Engine parameter to PostgreSQL: 15.0, 14.0, 13.0, 12.0, 11.0, and 10.0
parameters.name: engine_version

parameters.help_en:
The instance edition. Valid values:

Basic: RDS Basic Edition
HighAvailability: RDS High-availability Edition
Finance: RDS Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
实例系列。取值：
Basic：基础系列。
HighAvailability：高可用系列。
cluster：集群系列。
Finance：三节点企业系列
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en:
The storage type of the instance. Valid values:

local_ssd: local SSD
cloud_ssd: standard SSD
cloud_essd: enhanced SSD (ESSD) of performance level 1 (PL1)
cloud_essd2: ESSD of PL2
cloud_essd3: ESSD of PL3
parameters.help_zh:
实例存储类型，取值：
local_ssd：高性能本地盘。
general_essd：高性能云盘。
cloud_ssd：SSD云盘。
cloud_essd：ESSD PL1云盘。
cloud_essd2：ESSD PL2云盘。
cloud_essd3：ESSD PL3云盘
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The dedicated cluster ID. You can call the DescribeDedicatedHostGroups operation to query the dedicated cluster ID
parameters.help_zh: 专属集群ID。可调用DescribeDedicatedHostGroups接口查询
parameters.name: dedicated_host_group_id

parameters.help_en: The minor engine version of the instance. You can specify this parameter to query the minor engine version of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例小版本号。指定该值查询目标小版本详情。

该参数仅适用于RDS MySQL

对于RDS PostgreSQL实例，输入实例ID时，仅查询高于该实例当前小版本的所有小版本信息

parameters.name: region_id

MaxRecordsPerPage.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

MinorVersionItems.description_en: The details of the minor engine version

CommunityMinorVersion.description_en:
The PostgreSQL version to which the minor engine version corresponds. For more information, see [Release notes for AliPG]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/126002.html）.

This parameter is available only for instances that run PostgreSQL
CommunityMinorVersion.description_zh: 内核小版本对应的社区小版本

Engine.description_en: The database engine that corresponds to the minor engine version
Engine.description_zh: 小版本对应的数据库引擎

EngineVersion.description_en: The database engine version that corresponds to the minor engine version
EngineVersion.description_zh: 小版本对应的数据库版本

ExpireDate.description_en: The expiration time of the minor engine version

ExpireStatus.description_en:
The expiration status of the minor engine version. Valid values:

vaild
expired

If the minor engine version is in the Offline state, the minor engine version is discontinued. In this case, ignore the expiration status. If the minor engine version is in the Online state and the expiration state is expired, the minor engine version expires. If the expiration state is vaild, the minor engine version is still in its lifecycle
ExpireStatus.description_zh:
内核版本过期状态。返回值如下：

vaild：有效
expired：过期

下线状态为Offline时，表示版本已下线，此时忽略过期状态。下线状态为Online时，过期状态为expired，表示版本已超过生命周期；过期状态为vaild，表示版本仍在生命周期内
ExpireStatus.title_en: 内核版本过期状态：vaild-有效；expired-过期
ExpireStatus.title_zh: 内核版本过期状态：vaild-有效；expired-过期

IsHotfixVersion.description_en: An internal parameter. You do not need to specify this parameter

NodeType.description_en:
The RDS edition of the instance that runs the minor engine version. Valid values:

Basic: RDS Basic Edition
HighAvailability: RDS High-availability Edition
Finance: RDS Enterprise Edition
NodeType.description_zh:
小版本对应的实例系列。返回值：
Basic：基础系列。
HighAvailability：高可用系列。
Finance：三节点企业系列

ReleaseNote.description_en: The URL of the release notes for the minor engine version

ReleaseType.description_en:
The release type. Valid values:

LTS: a long-term version
BETA: a preview version
ReleaseType.description_zh:
发布类型。返回值：
LTS：长期支持版本。
BETA：预览版本

StatusDesc.description_en:
The status of the minor engine version. Valid values:

Offline: discontinued
Online: available

If the minor engine version is in the Offline state, the minor engine version is discontinued. In this case, ignore the expiration status. If the minor engine version is in the Online state and the expiration state is expired, the minor engine version expires. If the expiration state is vaild, the minor engine version is still in its lifecycle
StatusDesc.description_zh:
内核版本下线状态。返回值如下：
Offline：下线
Online：在线

下线状态为Offline时，表示版本已下线，此时忽略过期状态。下线状态为Online时，过期状态为expired，表示版本已超过生命周期；过期状态为vaild，表示版本仍在生命周期内
StatusDesc.title_en: 内核版本下线状态：offline-下线
StatusDesc.title_zh: 内核版本下线状态：offline-下线

Tag.description_en:
The tag that corresponds to the minor engine version. Valid values:

pgsql_docker_image: tag of common instances
pgsql_babelfish_image: tag of instances for which Babelfish is enabled

This parameter is available only for instances that run PostgreSQL
Tag.description_zh:
内核小版本对应的标签。返回值如下：

pgsql_docker_image：通用实例标签。
pgsql_babelfish_image：Babelfish实例标签。

当前仅PostgreSQL返回该值

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
